name: pixel3-animation
title: Pixel3 Animation
description: A pixel page transition (diagonal sweep). Click an image in the typographic intro and a grid of 7×13 pixel cells covers the view, swaps in that image's page, then clears; the pixel arrow plays it in reverse. Ported from the Codrops Pixel Transition demo 3, rewritten with Zepa content and Cloudinary images.
